jutsu.name: Earthen Bastion
jutsu.description: Calls the earth up to clad the user in a living fortress of molten-veined stone. Blows break against it, while every strike the user throws carries the weight of the mountain.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user drives a heel into the ground, and the earth answers with a roar. Jagged plates of stone tear free of the battlefield and slam shut around %user, veined with molten light, a living fortress that moves as they move. Blows that land against it crack and scatter like rain on a cliff face, while every strike %user throws carries the weight of the mountain behind it. For as long as the stone holds, %user stands as immovable as the land itself.

item.name: Night's Testament
item.description: “When the sun bears witness, this blade sleeps. When night falls, it remembers.”  Night’s Testament is not forged for war, but for judgment. Its edge is blackened not by fire, but by vows — each strike binding the wielder to the truth of what they’ve done. The markings along the blade are not decoration; they are testaments, etched as memories of every oath fulfilled and every silence kept.  In Seichi, it is said that:  the blade grows heavier with lies,  lighter with resolve,  and will not draw blood unless the wielder’s intent is absolute.  Those who survive its cut remember nothing. Those who fall become part of it.
item.battleDescription: %user holds a blade as dark as night. With one swift movement, too quick for the naked eye, the blade pierces through %target.

item.name: Stormrender
item.description: A blade made of lightning, said to have been used to cut a storm in half.
item.battleDescription: %user pulls out a katana, releasing a strong current through the blade. It begins to glow purple, and, as if empowered by lightning, %user slashes at %target.

item.name: Aetherion
item.description: A blade made from wind and fire chakra.
item.battleDescription: %user pulls out a blade and releases their dual-nature fire and wind chakra. The elements merge, strengthening the blade. %user then launches the blade at %target, cutting clean through.

jutsu.name: Prism
jutsu.description: Channel the light from the sun to enlighten the battlefield
jutsu.battleDescription: %user unleashes a blinding prism of light, striking %target dealing a devastating blow leaving them wounded.

jutsu.name: Jade
jutsu.description: Crystal Jade's jutsu, utilizing a crystal sword.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user focuses their chakra into an immense crystal prism, which shatters with a burst of power into countless razor-sharp fragments, scattering in a deadly storm toward %target.

jutsu.name: Crystal Lance Strike
jutsu.description: Summons a massive crystal lance to strike the enemy.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the ground, summoning a massive, radiant crystal lance that reflects all colors of the spectrum, and with a commanding gesture, hurls it at %target, shattering the ground and sending shockwaves as it impales and crushes them, obliterating their defenses with its immense power.

jutsu.name: Shattering Crystal Storm
jutsu.description: Launches a barrage of crystal shards at the enemy.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user concentrates their chakra into their palms, forming a crystalline glow before unleashing a torrent of sharp, glistening shards that fly like a storm of daggers, piercing even the toughest armor and leaving %target wounded and disoriented amidst the relentless assault.

item.name: Crystal Blade
item.description: A sword with a red crystal embedded into it. Channeling chakra into it lights it on fire.
item.battleDescription: %user sets their sword ablaze, cauterizing the wound as they cut into %target

jutsu.name: Founder’s Wrath
jutsu.description: Unleashes a massive attack by harnessing the origins of chakra.
jutsu.battleDescription: Drawing on the very origins of chakra, %user begins to chant an ancient incantation, their voice resonating with the primordial energy of creation. The ground trembles as elemental forces converge around %user—fire, water, earth, and lightning swirl into a tempest of raw power. With a final, commanding gesture, %user unleashes this elemental fury upon %target. The combined elements strike with devastating force, engulfing %target in a catastrophic storm that obliterates everything in its path. The sheer magnitude of the attack showcases the true power of the Heavenly Founder's legacy.

jutsu.name: Erupting Ground
jutsu.description: Shared pool record A3. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user forms the Boar seal and pours chakra deep into the earth beneath %target. The ground heaves and bursts upward in a column of rock and soil, battering everyone caught above it.

jutsu.name: Tamashī no Sakeme
jutsu.description: A devastating strike that cuts through both body and spirit.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user focuses their energy, and a dark aura begins to surround them. With a swift and decisive movement, they launch a blade of pure ethereal energy toward %target. This blade cuts through physical defenses like paper, but its true power lies in its ability to sever the connection between body and spirit. %target feels a cold, numbing pain as their very soul is sliced, leaving them disoriented, weakened, and vulnerable to further attacks. The wound left by this strike lingers, disrupting %target's chakra flow and making it difficult to recover.

jutsu.name: Celestial Sealing
jutsu.description: Seals the enemy's bloodline abilities.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's eyes glow with an ancient, divine energy, focusing intently on %target. With a series of intricate hand seals, they channel this energy into a binding force that surges towards %target. The celestial light surrounds %target, forming luminous chains that bind their body and spirit. These chains pulse with divine energy, penetrating deep into %target's chakra system. As %target struggles, %user completes the sealing technique, locking away %target's bloodline abilities. The celestial chains tighten, sealing %target's bloodline and rendering their unique abilities inert, leaving them vulnerable and powerless.

jutsu.name: Weakening Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S27. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user lands a precise blow on %target's sword arm, numbing it to the shoulder. Their attacks lose their force for a short time.

jutsu.name: Scorch Break
jutsu.description: Your most basic technique as a wielder of the Boil style

jutsu.name: Drowning Strike
jutsu.description: A fist of boiling water to the face.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user covers their fist in scorching hot water before striking %target in the face, forcing most of that water down their nostrils.

jutsu.name: Liquid Ember Shell

jutsu.battleDescription: %user merges fire and water chakra to form a molten liquid shell that absorbs attacks, with fire burning weaker assaults and water dissipating impacts, providing adaptive defense against various threats.

jutsu.name: Surfing Strike
jutsu.description: A series of gliding movements atop boiling water
jutsu.battleDescription: %user unleashes a torrent of water, flooding the battlefield. Using their Boil affinity, they glide seamlessly over the steaming surface, while the boiling water scalds %target causing %user to take less damage.

jutsu.name: Azure Dragon Palm
jutsu.description: Land devasting blows from the safety of your dragon.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user summons a water dragon that encases them like armor. Dashing toward %target, each strike they deliver is mirrored by the dragon, landing devastating blows that leave %target battered and overwhelmed.
